Ennovate ’20: the chapter’s first Enactus Day

1 February 2020 · By Enactus ARSD

Ennovate was announced by the chapter as its first-ever Enactus Day, scheduled for 5 February 2020.

The programme

  • A panel discussion bringing entrepreneurs and social-change voices together.
  • A case-study competition for teams drawn from across the college.
  • A quiz for students keen on business, social enterprise and current affairs.
  • An "ad-enacting" event for teams willing to stage their own advertisements live.

Ennovate went on to become a recurring format for the chapter — with the 2023 edition pairing a speaker session with the ideas fair.

This story is based on the chapter's own published update — read the original ↗
